lead_deck: Antalya tourism comes alive in July and August
lead_body: Akdeniz Turistik Otelciler ve İşletmeciler Birliği (AKTOB) President Kaan Kaşif Kavaloğlu stated that Antalya tourism was behind last year's figures in the first 6 months of the year. Kavaloğlu said that the most valuable period for the sector is July and August. Tourism activities reach their peak during this period.
